cases.source: A PC may touch the sigil. They mark a Stress.
Two PCs touch the sigil. They each mark a Stress.
A PC is Restrained. Another PC makes a Strength Roll to free the restrained PC. On a success, the restrained PC clears Restrained and marks a Stress.

A lantern guardian traps one PC in a binding ring. The trapped PC or a helper can attempt a Strength Roll to open the ring. If the attempt works, remove Restrained and mark 1 Stress. If it fails, mark 1 HP while the guardian recovers 1 HP.

A lantern guardian traps one PC in a binding ring. The trapped PC or a helper can attempt a Strength Roll to open the ring. If the attempt works, the trapped PC removes Restrained and the rolling PC marks 1 Stress. If it fails, the rolling PC marks 1 HP while the guardian recovers 1 HP.
A PC and an ally stand by the shrine. They mark a Stress.
